y-m-22-06.title: Different ways to divide jump-rope records into five classes
y-m-22-06.topic: Making frequency table: choosing starting value and class size to meet conditions
y-m-22-06.goal: Choose starting point and class size in different ways so every record fit, no class empty or overloaded; handle ‘less than’ boundary correctly and compare how distribution look based on design.
y-m-22-06.material:
Jump-rope counts (times, integers) for 16 students in 1 minute, from smallest to biggest:
8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 55
Arrange results in frequency table with five equal-size classes written ‘at least ○ times and below ○ times’. First class start at a times or more, class width w times (a natural number 0 or more, w natural number 1 or more). Classes go: a or more and below a+w; a+w or more and below a+2w; … Keep conditions: ① all 16 students fit in five classes ② no class empty ③ no class get more than 8 students (half total).
